name: codehealth-mcp
description: Code Health 1-10 maintainability scores and code smell reviews for ~30 languages, with pre-commit and pull request quality gates.
long_description: Scores source files 1-10 (Healthy >= 9, Warning >= 4, Alert < 4) and lists code smells such as Complex Method, Bumpy Road Ahead, Deep Nested Complexity and Code Duplication. Uses lizard and tree-sitter; PMD (optional, needs Java) adds copy-paste detection and Java God Class checks. All paths passed to the tools must be absolute.

tools.name: code_health_review
tools.description: Score one file and list its code smells with fix hints.

tools.name: pre_commit_code_health_safeguard
tools.description: Quality gate for staged and modified files against HEAD.

tools.name: analyze_change_set
tools.description: Quality gate for a branch against its merge base.

tools.name: rules_config_set_rule
tools.description: Set a rule weight in the rules file.

tools.name: rules_config_set_threshold
tools.description: Override a threshold in the rules file.

tools.name: explain_code_health
tools.description: Explain the model, a smell or the score bands.

pmd_home.title: PMD directory (optional)
pmd_home.description: A PMD 7 pmd-bin-* directory (from `codehealth install-pmd`). Leave empty to use the default location or run without PMD.
